description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding {C}{W}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Karoo.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
